text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Kgh... This is nothing...! 
...Add ten more sets! We press on!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Working Out
text_block_list.text:
...Is she adding more reps again...?! 
Her Trainer's a total drill sergeant 
too...!

Some time had passed in my life as 
Phalaenopsis's apprentice... 
and her training regimen gradually grew 
more grueling.

No matter how demanding the regimen, she 
tackles it without flinching. 
Every day, I witness firsthand that true 
resolve is proven through action.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's five sets of 1,600 meters 
complete. 
Now then, next is—

I quickly move her into the shade and take 
out a drink and cooling spray. 
Outdoor exercise in particular has a 
pronounced effect on body temperature.
choice_data_list: Let's resume once you've cooled down.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that was why the outdoor 
drills 
were split into such small intervals.
choice_data_list:
We've got to take frequent breaks as we 
go.
We need to take frequent breaks as we go.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
The Selection Race draws near. Step by 
step... we aim solely for victory.

...Knowing her, she would spare no effort 
in training for the race. 
Guiding that resolve to victory is my duty 
as her disciple—and yet.
choice_data_list: (...There is one decision I must make.)

text_block_list.text:
That night, I review the details of the 
Selection Race. Held under conditions 
equivalent to the Twinkle Series, the 
burden on its runners is substantial.
choice_data_list: (...Is it truly right to let her run?)

text_block_list.text:
...This decision could drastically alter 
her future. 
Fear gives rise to a momentary hesitation. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You wish to switch my Selection Race to 
dirt?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Even so, right now I want to 
minimize the strain.

Yes. Even so, right now I want to minimize 
the strain.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............ 
It is true that dirt places less impact 
upon the legs—and yet.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I told you to overcome your constitution. 
We should be able to train and build 
endurance to withstand turf's burden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This decision—are you planning to flee 
from turf? 
I have no memory of taking a coward for my 
disciple.

I spread our training records out across 
the desk. 
The projected load for each regimen... and 
countless figures in red that exceeded 
them.

With her ability, she would undoubtedly 
run well even on turf. 
However... I cannot force that burden upon 
her just for the present.
choice_data_list:
The Selection Race is the first step 
toward your future.

The Selection Race is the first step 
toward your future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
I want to give you a victory that connects 
to your future!

I want to give you a victory that leads 
into your future!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow, we begin final 
preparations for dirt. 
Reconstruct the entire regimen from 
scratch. ...Can you do that?

And so... the race arrives in the blink of 
an eye.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You know that girl over there? 
Word is she's been doing some insane 
Spartan training lately—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, her trainer must be tough as nails 
too... Wait, huh? 
Her Selection Race is on dirt? I was sure 
she'd be on turf—

From the stands, I watch the start. 
The chatter of the large crowd reaches my 
ears, making me straighten my back.
choice_data_list:
(Phaleno... show them what you're capable 
of!)

(Phaleno... show everyone what you're 
capable of!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Amid mounting anticipation, the Selection 
Race has now—begun!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First to break out in front is 
Phalaenopsis! 
She's picked up momentum and is tracking 
right behind the leader!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The dirt feels good, and my positioning 
is as planned. 
If I maintain this forward position and 
break away on the straight...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (However... this is not enough!)

Breath held, I watch her run. 
Just as the front runners smoothly enter 
the final straight—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, the race makes its move! 
Shaking off the front-runner, one runner 
has broken completely clear!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Phalaenopsis! Phalaenopsis takes the 
lead! 
What incredible acceleration—she won't let 
anyone close behind her!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot be content with just the lead... 
Farther ahead, push onward!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The reason I am able to run now... 
is because of all the decisions the club 
made for my sake.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (—And if you bear that same resolve...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I will reach it. No, I *will* make it 
reach! Beyond mere victory, toward...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The future!! Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The lead is five lengths, six lengths, and 
it just keeps growing! 
Displaying a breathtaking spectacle of 
speed, right now—!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
GOOOAAAL IN!!! 
With a staggering margin of nine lengths, 
she claims a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *Haa*, *haa*... *ha*, *hahaha*...!

With my heart racing, I sprint to her side 
and pull out a drink. 
After a run of that caliber, I must tend 
to her body temperature at once...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Well done!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Your daily devotion, and your decision for 
the future. 
This is truly a victory brought about by 
your hand.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to support an Umamusume and 
walk toward the future together. 
A piece of that resolve... now dwells 
indisputably within you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Continue to apply yourself with ever 
greater devotion.

A few days later, called upon by her, I 
visited the training club once more. 
Passing between the gently swaying 
flora... I stood before the gate.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno-saaan! 
Your disciple is here!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Now then—begin.

Caring for her cherished wooden naginata. 
—This was my final assignment as her 
disciple.

Sitting seiza before her, I wiped down the 
blade with the cloth she gave me. 
I carefully traced and cared for the 
beautifully polished wood grain.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Gentle and meticulous care—well done.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Step back now.

With those words, she began to dance. 
The naginata caught the sun, gleaming as 
though it had a sharpened blade.

Her every motion was dignified, yet 
fierce. 
I thought of her brilliant victory the 
other day—and of the happiness tied to her 
future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then—my disciple. 
In that race, you made a choice for my 
sake... and showed me your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You may consider the assignment fulfilled. 
—What will you do from here?
choice_data_list: I want to keep learning from you.

I wish to continue learning under your 
guidance.

text_block_list.text:
Like hers, true resolve is proven over 
time. 
And of course, as her trainer, I cannot 
simply remain on the receiving end.
choice_data_list:
And... I will support you on whatever path 
you take.

And... I will be there to support the path 
you walk.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Then let me ask one final question.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared to step into the 
future—together with me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our pact is sealed. 
As my disciple, and as my Trainer, support 
me... and see it with me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The great bloom of happiness—that shall 
blossom in the years yet to come.
